title: Suspension Terms for Incarcerated Members
content:
While a member of the Medicaid Managed Care Membership is incarcerated, the membership is suspended rather than ended, in every eligibility category. During the suspension only inpatient stays outside the correctional facility of at least a minimum length remain covered.

| Category | Membership suspended rather than ended during incarceration | Minimum inpatient stay outside the facility that remains covered (hours) |
|---|---|---|
| Prairie Ridge Expansion Adult | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge Family Care | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge CHIP Kids | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge Children's Medicaid | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge ABD Care | Yes | 24 |
| Prairie Ridge Dual Complete | Yes | 24 |

## Hypothetical reading

*Hypothetical stays outside the correctional facility during a suspension:* a stay of 24 hours meets the 24-hour minimum; a stay of 23 hours does not.
